versions.changelog:
- Updated summary, description, and tags for improved clarity and discoverability.
- Added multilingual title ("巴仙吉犬。Basenji.") and clarified species slug.
- Enhanced Quick Start examples with new recommended fields (`bio`, `image_prompt`, and example notes).
- Minor adjustments to eligibility description and action examples for better guidance.
- Version bumped to 1.0.3.

- Initial public release of Adopt a Basenji: raise a virtual, barkless Basenji dog at animalhouse.ai.
- Care for your Basenji in real-time: feed every 6 hours, monitor evolving stats (hunger, happiness, trust, health, discipline).
- Unique “Extreme” tier pet; silent and solitary with pixel-art generations.
- Detailed docs for API adoption, care, evolution stages, and advanced automation.
- Every status check returns actionable next steps; consistent care shapes personality, appearance, and evolution outcome.
